team.title: Team members and invitations.
team.description: Team members sign in with Google. WhatsApp clients are managed separately in Contacts and do not need a PartsRelay login.

members.title: Workspace members
members.description: Owners manage the company and team. Admins manage contacts and viewers. Viewers can run searches and view contacts.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.description: The new owner manages the company, its WhatsApp language and the team, and can delete the company. You become an Admin, and only the new owner can undo this.
transfer.nobody: Nobody else is in the team yet. Invite someone first, then transfer ownership to them.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Each link works only for the invited email address and expires after 7 days.

invite.title: Invite a teammate
invite.description: Send an invitation to the Google account email your teammate will use to sign in.

errors.member: This person is already in the team.
errors.invited: This person already has a pending invitation.

hints.admin: Admins manage contacts and can invite or remove viewers.
hints.viewer: Viewers run searches and see contacts, without managing them.
hints.admin-invites-viewers: As an admin you can invite viewers.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: {{name}} loses access to {{company}} and their account is deleted, together with the invitations they sent. Searches they ran stay with the company.

revoke.title: Revoke the invitation for {{email}}?
revoke.body: The invitation link stops working straight away. You can invite them again later.

notices.ownership-transferred: Ownership transferred to {{name}}. You're now an Admin.
notices.member-removed: {{name}} was removed and their account deleted.
notices.invitation-revoked: Invitation revoked. The link no longer works.

safeguards.title: Ownership and access safeguards
safeguards.description: Ownership changes and removing a teammate require confirmation. Removing a member deletes their account; searches they ran stay with the company.
